$comment: The GUI-scope boundary, declared. Each key is a bare specifier that scripts/lib/gui-scope-hooks.mjs re-resolves from packages/scratch-gui for a ROOT test; `tests` lists every root test that causes it (repo-relative). scripts/check-gui-scope.mjs fails the CI unit step by name on any specifier or test not here. Exact list, no wildcards. The original boundary was measured 2026-09-06 in run 34012073586; Track A adds the named tests whose owned overlay imports cross the same dependency boundary. Adding an entry is a review decision made in the same commit as the import.

avr8js.why: owned board/Arduboy sources import the AVR adapter, debug target or chip table; avr8js belongs to the GUI package rather than the root test package

rp2040js.why: owned RP2040 adapter/debug sources execute the GUI package's rp2040js core

scratch-vm/src/index.js.why: VM integration tests need the patched Scratch VM source entry that the GUI webpack build consumes, not the package's unpatched dist bundle
